# Administer an employee equity plan

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

As grants, vesting, exercises, departures and plan reporting recur after an equity plan is established. An owned equity-administration calendar and reconciled grant register with exceptions and reporting assigned.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Reconcile plan documents and award records

agent-runnable


Gather the approved plan, reserve, amendments, grants and transaction history. Compare the cap table, grant documents and payroll records and identify unsupported awards or inconsistent balances.

- Sources: [IRS stock options, Topic 427](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc427) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Confirm the administration and reporting rules

human · human approval required


Counsel and tax advisers define eligibility, approval rights, event handling and reporting by entity and participant location. Record the specific plan terms and leave unresolved cross-border treatment open.

- Sources: [IRS stock options, Topic 427](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc427) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Create an event and evidence calendar

agent-runnable


Track vesting, exercises, leavers, expiries, valuations and required returns with owners and source documents. Separate forecast dilution from issued shares and distinguish a draft grant from an approved executed award.

- Sources: [IRS stock options, Topic 427](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc427) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Review and authorize plan events

human · human approval required


The authorized approvers review each grant, amendment, exercise or cancellation against the plan and reserve. Use the existing grant or exercise process for execution rather than allowing an administrative entry to create rights.

- Sources: [IRS stock options, Topic 427](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc427) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Reconcile the plan after each reporting period

agent-runnable


Match approved events, holder communications, payroll and equity-register changes. Have advisers review reporting and financial-statement support and assign correction owners for discrepancies.

- Verify: An owned equity-administration calendar and reconciled grant register with exceptions and reporting assigned.
- Sources: [IRS stock options, Topic 427](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc427) · [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)
